AUDIT_ARCHIVE_BUCKET.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket name for sealed audit SQLite archives (.sqlite.zst objects). Required in production. In local development, omit when using a disk-backed object store (e.g. USE_DISK_OBJECT_STORE=true); the seal pipeline must not upload to GCS without a non-empty bucket name outside NODE_ENV=test when using GCS.

AUDIT_DIGEST_RECIPIENT.description: Google Group email address that receives each audit seal digest (archive hash, chain tail, window bounds). Required in production. Optional in local development; the seal pipeline must not run without a non-empty value outside NODE_ENV=test.

AUDIT_LOCAL_RETENTION_DAYS.description: How many days sealed audit archive files remain on local disk after a successful upload and digest email, before they may be deleted. Non-negative decimal integer as a string.
